title: HandLive — new SMS notification content (Mac, iPhone, iPad)
description: SMS-02 API 4: the UNNotificationRequest content of a new SMS, written as JSON. Not a wire message: it fixes the identifiers and the userInfo that M-APP, I-APP and I-NSE share (SMS-05 API 2 removes notifications by userInfo).

identifier.description: sms:<pair_id>:<message_key>; a notification created by a push has an identifier set by the system.

title.description: display_name, or the number in national format; group conversations: the names joined with ", ".

subtitle.description: Label of the SIM of sub_id; empty when the phone has 1 SIM.

body.description: The message body, or sms.notification_hidden_body when sms.preview = false.

threadIdentifier.description: sms:<pair_id>:<thread_id>: groups the notifications of one conversation; for a push, I-NSE sets it after decrypting (the APNs thread-id is the generic sms, CONN-04 API 4).

categoryIdentifier.description: HL_SMS (actions HL_SMS_REPLY, HL_SMS_MARK_READ); HL_SMS_GROUP for conversations with several addresses (only HL_SMS_MARK_READ).
